questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Uttar Pradesh / accounts for about 16 per cent / of the / country population.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**country population**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the sentence tells us that Uttar Pradesh has 16 percent of the total population of the country.
 
• In the above sentence instead of "**country population" it should be "country's population".**
 
• We use apostrophe to show possession of something over the other.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

Correct sentence__: *Uttar Pradesh accounts for about 16 per cent of the **country's **population.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• An apostrophe is a small punctuation mark ( ' ) placed after a noun to show that the noun owns something. 
 
• The apostrophe will always be placed either before or after an "s" at the end of the noun.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Community leaders were __baffled__ by the sudden arrival of the President.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Composed__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antonym **means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word. 
 
• The word **baffled** means completely perplex or perplex.
 
• The word **composed **means having control over one's emotions and expression; serenity.
 
• The meaning of word baffled is opposite of the meaning of word composed, **hence the correct answer is composed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Thwarted **is the past tense of word thwart which means prevent (someone) from doing something.

*Example *: The army **thwarted **the attempt at a coup.

 
• The word **flustered **is an adjective which means confused.

*Example *: He was so **flustered **that he forgot to eat.

 
• The word **confused **means unable to think.

*Example *: I am so **confused **about what to eat.

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

He was __on cloud nine__ after passing the test.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is on __**cloud nine**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Idioms are a collection of words established by usage as having a meaning distinct from the meanings of the individual words.
 
• The meaning of idiom on **cloud nine** is extremely happy.
 
• The **meaning **of above sentence is that as he cleared his exam he was very happy.
 
• *Example *: My mother is on **cloud nine** today as she won lottery.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Some more idioms on **happiness **are :

 
• **Like a dog with two tails** - to be very cheerful and happy

*Example *: Jim is behaving **like a dog with two tails** today.

 
• **Full of joys of the spring** - to look and be very happy

*Example *: My parents are **full of joys of the spring** after meeting their grandchild.

 
• **On the top of world** - feeling very happy.

*Example *: After scoring well I feel like being **on the top of world.**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Evident
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hidden**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Antonym **means a phrase or word with the opposite meaning as another phrase or word. 
 
• The word **Evident** is an adjective which means seen clearly or in-front of eyes.
 
• The word **Hidden** is an adjective which means not visible.
 
• The meaning of Evident is opposite to the meaning of Hidden,* hence the correct answer is Hidden.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word **Obvious **is an adjective which is synonym of Evident and it means apparent.

questions.solution:

• In the above sentence there should be **are present at instead of are presently at.**
 
• The word **presently **is an adverb which is used to signify that (present) very moment.

• The word **present **is an adjective which means being at a place.

*Example *: All the students must be **present** in tomorrow's class.

• When we are describing change, we use **into **after verbs.

*Example *: Come **into **the house.

 
• The word **at **is a preposition. We use at to refer to a specific time or location. It is also used to refer to activities.

*Example *: We are **at **auditorium.
